summary.text: Bruce Ayers is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Norfolk District who has served since 1999 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Quincy city councilor, he is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Bruce Ayers served on the Quincy City Council from 1992 to 2000 and on the Quincy Democratic City Committee from 1990 to 2000, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a small business owner.
Ayers assumed office in the Massachusetts House in 1999.

For 2025-2026 he was vice chair of the Education Joint Committee and was also assigned to the Labor and Workforce Development, Public Health, and Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development joint committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
